section.content: The utility model discloses a microbial gene detection device, which belongs to the technical field of microbial detection and comprises an outer shell, a filtrate inner cylinder, a sealing cover, a sliding buckling mechanism, a filtrate mechanism and an elastic support piece, wherein the sealing cover is used for sealing the same end of the outer shell and the filtrate inner cylinder, the sliding buckling mechanism is arranged between the outer shell and the side wall of the filtrate inner cylinder and used for calibrating the liquid taking amount of the filtrate inner cylinder, the filtrate mechanism is used for separating supernatant liquid generated by centrifugation in the outer shell, and the elastic support piece is arranged between the outer shell and the filtrate mechanism and used for limiting and supporting the filtrate inner cylinder. The utility model provides a microbial gene detection device, which can quantitatively filter supernatant generated by centrifugation in an outer shell as required by sliding a filtrate inner cylinder arranged in the outer shell, and has the functions of quantitatively removing liquid and preventing secondary pollution.

本实用新型公开了一种微生物基因检测装置，属于微生物检测技术领域，本实用新型包括外壳体、滤液内筒、封盖、滑动扣合机构、滤液机构和弹性支撑件，其中封盖用于将外壳体和滤液内筒的同一端密封，滑动扣合机构，设置在所述外壳体与所述滤液内筒侧壁之间，用于标定滤液内筒的取液量，滤液机构用于分离外壳体内离心产生的上清液，弹性支撑件设置在所述外壳体与所述滤液机构之间，用于对所述滤液内筒限位和支撑。本实用新型提供了一种微生物基因检测装置，通过滑动设置在外壳体中的滤液内筒，可将外壳体中离心产生的上清液按需求定量滤除，具有定量去液、防止二次污染的功能。

Microbial gene detection deviceTechnical Field

The utility model relates to the technical field of microbial detection, in particular to a microbial gene detection device.

Background

The microorganisms include bacteria, viruses, fungi, a few algae and the like, are classified into space microorganisms, marine microorganisms and the like according to different existing environments, are classified into prokaryotic microorganisms and eukaryotic microorganisms according to the classification of cell mechanisms, and need to extract genetic materials contained in the microorganisms when the microorganisms are subjected to gene detection.

The existing microorganism DNA extraction method comprises the technical means of a rapid extraction method, a protease method, a phenol/chloroform/isoamyl alcohol extraction method, a standard extraction method and the like, and the main means is to separate supernatant fluid and liquid to be extracted by a centrifuge after DNA genetic substances are cultured and amplified, and then to extract DNA from dissolved precipitates by a salt solution method.

When supernatant is removed after centrifugation, the conventional operation means is to manually suck by a liquid shifter, which easily causes the problems of external pollution and uneven liquid taking quantity.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

In view of the shortcomings of the prior art, an object of the embodiments of the present invention is to provide a microorganism gene detection apparatus, so as to solve the above problems in the background art.

In order to achieve the purpose, the utility model provides the following technical scheme:

the utility model provides a little biological gene detection device, includes shell body and filtrating inner tube, still includes: the sealing cover is rotatably connected with the outer shell and is used for sealing the same end of the outer shell and the filtrate inner cylinder; the sliding buckling mechanism is arranged between the outer shell and the side wall of the filtrate inner cylinder and is used for calibrating the liquid taking amount of the filtrate inner cylinder; a filtrate mechanism for separating supernatant produced by centrifugation in the outer shell; and the elastic supporting piece is arranged between the outer shell and the filtrate mechanism and used for limiting and supporting the filtrate inner barrel.

As a further aspect of the present invention, the slide buckle mechanism includes: the limiting assembly is arranged on the inner wall surface of the outer shell and used for guiding and limiting the filtrate inner barrel; and the bulge piece is fixedly assembled outside the filtrate inner cylinder and used for limiting the sliding of the filtrate inner cylinder.

As a further scheme of the utility model, the limiting component comprises a groove which is linearly distributed on the wall surface of the inner cavity of the outer shell; the transverse notches are arranged on one side of the groove in parallel and used for calibrating the liquid taking amount; and the buckling groove is communicated with the transverse groove opening and is used for buckling and limiting the protruding piece.

As a further aspect of the present invention, the filtrate mechanism includes: the bottom plate is positioned on one side of the filtrate inner cylinder, which faces the far end of the sealing cover; the first liquid outlet holes are circumferentially distributed on the plane of the bottom plate and used for seeping out supernatant liquid generated by centrifugation; and the outward rotating component is movably assembled at the outer side of the bottom plate and is used for separating supernatant liquid generated by centrifugation.

As a further aspect of the present invention, the outward rotation assembly includes: the rotating member is rotatably assembled on the outer side of the bottom plate and is coaxially arranged with the bottom plate; the second liquid outlet holes are circumferentially distributed on the surface of the rotary member and are opposite to the first liquid outlet holes; and the meshing component is fixedly assembled on one side of the rotating component and used for elastically limiting the filtrate inner barrel.

As a further aspect of the present invention, the elastic support includes: the shell is fixedly assembled on one side, facing the filtrate inner cylinder, of the inner part of the outer shell; and the sliding part is assembled in the shell in a sliding manner, and the front end of the sliding part is meshed and connected with the meshing part and is used for limiting the sliding of the filtrate inner barrel.

As a further proposal of the utility model, the filtrate inner cylinder is provided with a knob piece towards one side of the cover cap for assembling and taking out the filtrate inner cylinder.

In summary, compared with the prior art, the embodiment of the utility model has the following beneficial effects:

the utility model provides a microbial gene detection device, which can quantitatively filter supernatant generated by centrifugation in an outer shell as required by sliding a filtrate inner cylinder arranged in the outer shell, and has the functions of quantitatively removing liquid and preventing secondary pollution.

To more clearly illustrate the structural features and effects of the present invention, the present invention will be described in detail below with reference to the accompanying drawings and specific embodiments.

Drawings

FIG. 1 is a schematic structural view of a microbial gene detection apparatus provided in an embodiment of the present invention.

FIG. 2 is a schematic structural diagram of a filtrate inner barrel of the microbial gene detection apparatus provided in an embodiment of the present invention.

FIG. 3 is a schematic structural diagram of an outer casing of the microbial gene detection device according to an embodiment of the present invention.

Reference numerals: the filter element comprises a shell 1, a filter liquid cylinder 2, a groove 3, a thread 4, a seal cover 5, a pinching piece 6, a protrusion 7, a bottom plate 8, a first liquid outlet hole 9, a rotary member 10, a second liquid outlet hole 11, a meshing member 12, a transverse notch 14, a buckling groove 15, a shell 16, a sliding member 17 and a spring 18.

Detailed Description

In order to make the objects, technical solutions and advantages of the present invention more apparent, the present invention is described in further detail below with reference to the accompanying drawings and embodiments. It should be understood that the specific embodiments described herein are merely illustrative of the utility model and are not intended to limit the utility model.

Specific implementations of the present invention are described in detail below with reference to specific embodiments.

As shown in fig. 1, a microbial gene detection device, the device includes an outer casing 1 and a filtrate inner cylinder 2, and further includes: the sealing cover 5 is rotationally connected with the outer shell 1 and is used for sealing the same end of the outer shell 1 and the filtrate inner cylinder 2; the sliding buckling mechanism is arranged between the outer shell 1 and the side wall of the filtrate inner cylinder 2 and is used for calibrating the liquid taking amount of the filtrate inner cylinder 2; a filtrate mechanism for separating supernatant produced by centrifugation in the outer casing 1; and the elastic supporting piece is arranged between the outer shell 1 and the filtrate mechanism and used for limiting and supporting the filtrate inner cylinder 2.

This embodiment is when practical application, take behind the microbial culture arranges shell body 1 in, cup joint 5 rotations of closing cap on thread 4, close shell body 1's uncovered, arrange shell body 1 in intermediate speed centrifuge centrifugal oscillation, the inside filtrating mechanism of shell body 1 is in the open mode this moment, the mixed liquid that contains the microorganism is after the centrifugation, the less supernatant of density passes the mixed liquid upper strata of filtrating mechanism suspension in filtrating inner tube 2, open closing cap 5 back rotatory filtrating inner tube 2 this moment, and elastic support through the bottom meshing makes filtrating mechanism seal, and make the supernatant remain in the intracavity of filtrating inner tube 2, outwards take out filtrating inner tube 2 along slip lock mechanism, can leave quantitative mixed liquid after straining in shell body 1.

In one aspect of the present embodiment, the outer casing 1 may have a cylindrical shape, or may have a plurality of shapes such as a strip shape, and the filtrate inner cylinder 2 is slidably mounted inside the outer casing, and is not particularly limited herein.

In one case of the present embodiment, the cover 5 is only required to be able to seal the outer casing 1, and the specific structure is not particularly limited.

As shown in fig. 2 and 3, in an embodiment of the present invention, the sliding buckle mechanism includes: the limiting assembly is arranged on the inner wall surface of the outer shell 1 and used for guiding and limiting the filtrate inner barrel; and the bulge part 7 is fixedly assembled outside the filtrate inner cylinder 2 and used for limiting the sliding of the filtrate inner cylinder 2.

In one aspect of the present embodiment, the protrusion 7 and the limiting component can be disposed at any position of the contact surface of the outer housing 1 and the filtrate inner barrel 2, as long as the function of sliding limiting can be achieved, and are not limited specifically here.

As shown in fig. 3, in a preferred embodiment of the present invention, the limiting component comprises a groove 3 linearly arranged on the wall surface of the inner cavity of the outer shell 1; the transverse notches 14 are arranged on one side of the groove 3 in parallel and used for calibrating the liquid taking amount; and the buckling groove 15 is communicated with the transverse notch 14 and is used for buckling and limiting the convex piece 7.

In practical application of the embodiment, when the protrusion 7 on the outer side of the filtrate inner cylinder 2 is pushed into the outer shell 1 along the groove 3, the filtrate inner cylinder 2 is attached to the inner wall of the outer shell 1 to slide under the guiding action of the groove 3, and when the bottom of the filtrate inner cylinder 2 is in contact with the elastic supporting member, the filtrate inner cylinder 2 is rotated by the kneading piece 6 to axially rotate the protrusion 7 and is clamped into the transverse notch 14, and after the kneading piece 6 is released, the filtrate inner cylinder 2 clamps the protrusion 7 into the clamping groove 15 under the acting force of the elastic supporting member, so that the filtrate inner cylinder 2 is fixed at a required position.

In one aspect of this embodiment, the groove 3 is a straight groove structure, which facilitates rapid assembly and replacement of the filtrate inner cylinder 2, and a margin gap is reserved between the protrusion 7 and the groove 3, so that when the filtrate inner cylinder 2 is taken out, pressures at the inner end and the outer end of the filtrate inner cylinder 2 tend to be balanced, and the filtrate inner cylinder 2 is taken out conveniently.

As shown in fig. 2, in a preferred embodiment of the present embodiment, the filtrate mechanism includes: the bottom plate 8 is positioned on one side of the filtrate inner barrel 2 facing the far end of the seal cover 5; the first liquid outlet holes 9 are circumferentially distributed on the plane of the bottom plate 8 and are used for seeping out supernatant liquid generated by centrifugation; and an outward rotating assembly movably mounted at an outer side of the bottom plate 8 for separating supernatant generated by centrifugation, the outward rotating assembly comprising: the rotating member 10 is rotatably assembled on the outer side of the bottom plate 8 and is arranged coaxially with the bottom plate 8; the second liquid outlet holes 11 are circumferentially distributed on the surface of the rotating member 10, and the second liquid outlet holes 11 are opposite to the first liquid outlet holes 9; and the meshing component 12 is fixedly assembled at one side of the rotating component 10 and used for elastically limiting the filtrate inner barrel 2.

In practical application, when the filtrate inner cylinder 2 is assembled into the outer shell 1, the first liquid outlet hole 9 and the second liquid outlet hole 11 are in a staggered state, so that the filtrate inner cylinder 2 is isolated from the cavity of the outer shell 1, when the meshing part 12 is meshed with the elastic supporting part, the bottom plate 8 is rotated around the meshing part 12 by rotating the filtrate inner cylinder 2, so that the first liquid outlet hole 9 is matched with the second liquid outlet hole 11, and the filtrate inner cylinder 2 is communicated with the outer shell 1.

In one aspect of the present embodiment, the rotating member 10 can be assembled outside the filtrate inner barrel 2, or can be assembled inside the filtrate inner barrel 2, as long as it can perform a rotary sealing effect on the first outlet hole 9 on the filtrate inner barrel 2, and is not particularly limited herein.

In one aspect of the present embodiment, the specific positions of the first liquid outlet hole 9 and the second liquid outlet hole 11 are not fixedly limited, as long as the first liquid outlet hole 9 and the second liquid outlet hole 11 can be matched with each other, and the deflection angle is matched with the rotation angle of the protruding part 7 on the transverse notch 14.

As shown in fig. 1, in a preferred embodiment of the present invention, the elastic support member includes: the shell 16 is fixedly assembled inside the outer shell 1 and faces to one side of the filtrate inner cylinder 2; and the sliding part 17 is assembled in the shell 16 in a sliding manner, and the front end of the sliding part 17 is meshed and connected with the meshing part 12 and is used for limiting the sliding of the filtrate inner barrel 2.

In practical application, when the filtrate inner barrel 2 slides along the inner cavity of the outer shell 1, the sliding part 17 is engaged with the engaging part 12 on the outer side of the filtrate inner barrel 2 in a snap-fit manner, and at the moment, the sliding part 17 plays an axial limiting role on the engaging part 12.

In one aspect of this embodiment, the sliding member 17 is a bar-shaped link, which effectively prevents the sliding member 17 from rotating axially in the housing 16, and ensures that the engaging member 12 engaged at one end thereof is in a relatively stationary state.

The embodiment of the utility model provides a microbial gene detection device, and an outer shell 1 and a filtrate inner cylinder 2 are provided based on the microbial gene detection device, and a supernatant generated by centrifugation in the outer shell 1 can be quantitatively filtered out as required through the filtrate inner cylinder 2 arranged in a sliding manner, so that the microbial gene detection device has the functions of quantitatively removing liquid and preventing secondary pollution.

In the description of the present invention, it is to be understood that the terms "upper", "one side", "inside", and the like indicate orientations or positional relationships based on the orientations or positional relationships shown in the drawings, which are only for convenience of describing the present invention and simplifying the description, but do not indicate or imply that the microbial gene testing device or element referred to must have a specific orientation, be constructed in a specific orientation, and be operated, and that unless otherwise specifically stated or limited, the terms "set", "assembled", "connected", and "connected" are to be interpreted broadly, e.g., as being fixedly connected, detachably connected, or integrally connected; can be mechanically or electrically connected; the terms may be directly connected or indirectly connected through an intermediate, and may be used for communicating the inside of two elements or interacting relation of two elements, unless otherwise specifically defined, and the specific meaning of the above terms in the present invention may be understood by those skilled in the art according to specific situations.

The above description is only for the purpose of illustrating the preferred embodiments of the present invention and is not to be construed as limiting the utility model, and any modifications, equivalents and improvements made within the spirit and principle of the present invention are intended to be included within the scope of the present invention.
